svg.title: RBF support-vector geometry and a signed class-pair decision
svg.desc: Four hypothetical support vectors at (−1, ±1) for class A and (1, ±1) for class B define an analytic RBF C-SVC model with gamma 0.5, C 10 and zero offset. Dashed contours mark decision values +1 and −1; the solid vertical boundary marks zero. The query (−0.5, 0) has squared distances 1.25 and 3.25, giving similarities 0.5353 and 0.1969. A second kernel curve shows the faster decay at gamma 1.0. A waterfall adds the four signed contributions, giving f=0.6893 and a vote for A.
svg.text: C Add the signed support-vector contributions
